question: What Is a Bojangles Bo-Berry Biscuit?
quick_answer: A Bo-Berry Biscuit is Bojangles' sweet, dessert-style biscuit: a made-from-scratch buttermilk biscuit baked with blueberry-flavored bits (the 'Bo-Berries') and finished with a sweet sugar icing drizzle. It is a signature treat, sold individually or by the box, and tastes more like a glazed pastry than a plain biscuit.
key_facts: A sweet biscuit with blueberry-flavored bits and sugar icing
Made from Bojangles' scratch buttermilk biscuit dough
Sold individually or by the box (for sharing)
A dessert-style item, sweeter than a regular biscuit

body.heading: What's in a Bo-Berry Biscuit
body.text: The Bo-Berry Biscuit starts with the same made-from-scratch buttermilk biscuit Bojangles is known for, but it is studded with sweet blueberry-flavored bits (the Bo-Berries) and then drizzled with a sugary white icing. The result is soft, sweet and closer to a pastry or scone than a traditional savory biscuit.

body.heading: How Bojangles serves it
body.text: Bo-Berry Biscuits are a popular morning and anytime treat. You can order them individually or by the box, which makes them a common choice to share or bring to the office. They pair naturally with Bojangles' coffee or sweet tea.

body.heading: Is it a dessert?
body.text: Effectively, yes. While it sits on the breakfast menu, the Bo-Berry Biscuit is really a sweet treat thanks to the blueberry bits and icing. Many people order it as a dessert or a sweet add-on to a savory meal like fried chicken or a chicken biscuit.

faqs.q: Are Bo-Berry Biscuits made with real blueberries?
faqs.a: They are made with sweet blueberry-flavored bits baked into the biscuit dough, then drizzled with sugar icing, rather than whole fresh blueberries.

faqs.q: Can you buy Bo-Berry Biscuits by the box?
faqs.a: Yes. Bojangles sells Bo-Berry Biscuits individually or by the box, which makes them easy to share.
Yes. With blueberry bits and a sugar icing drizzle, it is a sweet, dessert-style biscuit rather than a plain savory one.
